name: Quaking Slither

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Monsters of Myth

disable: three DC 38 Athletics check (trained), DC 38 Crafting check (trained), or Engineering Lore (trained) checks to brace a small structure or surface to cancel the effects of the quake in that area, or a single DC 41 Diplomacy check (master) check to entreat Ebeshra to stand down
reset: Ebeshra doesn't rush this way again for 1d4 rounds.

items.name: Quake
items.text:
Trigger Ebeshra moves at least 60 feet on land

---

Effect The ground shakes in a 120-foot emanation from Ebeshra's space. This creates a variety of effects depending on the surrounding environment.

In an area without significant underground space, the ground becomes greater difficult terrain, and creatures on it are Off-Guard and Clumsy 2 for 1 round.

In areas with existing underground spaces (like sewers, sinkholes, or catacombs), fissures open up in the ground. Creatures in the area tumble into the resulting 80-foot-deep hole unless they succeed at a DC 40 Reflex save save.

In bays, on beaches, and in other relatively substantial but shallow bodies of water, the tremors create dangerous waves. Creatures in the water or within 60 feet of the waterline are struck by waves that deal 10d8 bludgeoning damage (DC 35 basic Reflex save save). On a critical failure, a creature is instantly swept 60 feet out to sea and 60 feet under the water's surface.

text: Ebeshra slithers across the ground, causing the earth to tremble as though from a powerful earthquake.
